subject.title: Feature: Support Telegram media groups (albums) in message tool

question: Should Telegram album support group existing mediaUrls automatically at the Telegram send boundary, expose a new explicit media-group action/parameter, or stay documented as sequential sends for now?
rationale: The remaining work is a user-visible Telegram message-tool/channel behavior change that spans direct actions, reply delivery, and outbound payload delivery, so automation should not choose the permanent API shape or fallback policy without maintainer intent.

options.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
options.body: Add sendMediaGroup as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

options.title: Rework the explicit draft action
options.body: Use the linked draft PR's send-media-group/filePaths action as the product direction, but require a current-main rewrite and live proof before landing.

options.title: Keep sequential sends for now
options.body: Defer album grouping and document that multi-media Telegram sends currently deliver as separate Telegram messages.

recommendation.title: Use existing mediaUrls semantics
recommendation.body: Add sendMediaGroup as a Telegram delivery optimization for existing structured multi-media payloads and keep sequential fallback for unsupported cases.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete already reviewed this issue and has the strongest current routing signal across the central Telegram send/action/outbound files.
